## `cities`

Canonical cities and areas (New Cairo, Sheikh Zayed, North Coast, ...).

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | no | primary key | Identity primary key. |
| `name_en` | text | no | unique | Official English name. Used in exports. Unique. |
| `name_ar` | text | no |  | Official Arabic name. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was created. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was last changed. |

## `developers`

Canonical real estate developers (Emaar Misr, SODIC, Palm Hills, ...).

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | no | primary key | Identity primary key. |
| `name_en` | text | no | unique | Official English name. Used in exports. Unique. |
| `name_ar` | text | no |  | Official Arabic name. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was created. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was last changed. |

## `entity_aliases`

Alternate spellings (Arabic, English, abbreviations) mapped to one city, developer or project. Exactly one of the three entity columns is set.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | no | primary key | Identity primary key. |
| `alias` | text | no |  | The spelling as written, kept for display and review. |
| `alias_normalized` | text | no |  | The spelling after normalizeName(): lowercase, unified Arabic letters, no diacritics or punctuation. Matching uses this column. |
| `city_id` | integer | yes | → cities.id | Set when the alias names a city. |
| `developer_id` | integer | yes | → developers.id | Set when the alias names a developer. |
| `project_id` | integer | yes | → projects.id | Set when the alias names a project. |
| `source` | text | no |  | Where the alias came from: `seed` (seed data), `manual` (added by the owner), `review` (learned from a review-queue correction). |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the alias was added. |

**Indexes and constraints**

- Unique index `entity_aliases_city_alias_key` on (city_id, alias_normalized)
- Unique index `entity_aliases_developer_alias_key` on (developer_id, alias_normalized)
- Unique index `entity_aliases_project_alias_key` on (project_id, alias_normalized)
- Index `entity_aliases_alias_trgm_idx` on (expression) using gin
- Check `entity_aliases_exactly_one_entity`

## `extraction_runs`

Every model call (classification or extraction): request, answer, tokens, cost, latency. Reprocessing adds new rows and never deletes old ones.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | bigint | no | primary key | Identity primary key. |
| `message_id` | bigint | no | → messages.id | The message the model read. |
| `purpose` | text | no |  | `classify` (what the message is about) or `extract` (copy out units). |
| `prompt_version` | text | no |  | Version string of the prompt used, e.g. `extract-2026-10-26.1`. |
| `provider` | text | no |  | `cerebras`, `openrouter`, ... |
| `model` | text | no |  | Model name at the provider. |
| `request` | jsonb | no |  | The request body as sent (no API key). Contact details are removed before sending. |
| `raw_output` | text | yes |  | The answer from the model, unchanged. |
| `parsed` | jsonb | yes |  | The answer after validation, when valid. |
| `input_tokens` | integer | yes |  | Tokens sent. |
| `output_tokens` | integer | yes |  | Tokens received. |
| `cost_usd` | numeric(12, 6) | yes |  | Cost in USD (0 on free tiers; null when the price of the model is unknown). |
| `latency_ms` | integer | no |  | Time the call took. |
| `status` | text | no |  | `ok`, `invalid` (answer failed validation), `error`, `rate_limited` or `timeout`. |
| `error` | text | yes |  | Error or validation message. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the call was made. |

**Indexes and constraints**

- Index `extraction_runs_message_idx` on (message_id)
- Index `extraction_runs_created_at_idx` on (created_at)
- Check `extraction_runs_purpose_check`
- Check `extraction_runs_status_check`

## `media_files`

The image, video, voice note or document attached to a message. Identical files are stored once on disk (named by hash).

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | bigint | no | primary key | Identity primary key. |
| `message_id` | bigint | no | unique, → messages.id | The message the file belongs to (one file per message). |
| `kind` | text | no |  | `image`, `video`, `audio` or `document`. |
| `mime_type` | text | yes |  | File type reported by WhatsApp, e.g. `image/jpeg`, `application/pdf`. |
| `file_name` | text | yes |  | Original file name, for documents. |
| `size_bytes` | bigint | yes |  | File size in bytes. |
| `sha256` | text | yes |  | SHA-256 of the file contents (hex). The same flyer in three groups has one hash. |
| `path` | text | yes |  | Location relative to MEDIA_DIR, e.g. `ab/cd/abcd...e9.jpg`. |
| `status` | text | no |  | `pending` (not downloaded yet), `downloaded`, `failed` (gave up after retries) or `skipped` (too large). |
| `attempts` | integer | no |  | Download attempts so far. |
| `error` | text | yes |  | Last download error. |
| `media_ref` | jsonb | no |  | What WhatsApp needs to download the file again. Contains no sender data. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was created. |
| `downloaded_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  | When the file was saved to disk. |

**Indexes and constraints**

- Index `media_files_sha256_idx` on (sha256)
- Index `media_files_status_idx` on (status)
- Check `media_files_status_check`
- Check `media_files_kind_check`

## `messages`

Raw messages from watched groups, stored once and never changed by processing except for `status`, `error` and `attempts`.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | bigint | no | primary key | Identity primary key. |
| `group_id` | integer | no | → wa_groups.id | The group the message was posted in. |
| `wa_message_id` | text | no |  | WhatsApp message ID. Unique per group, which prevents duplicates. |
| `sender_hash` | text | no |  | HMAC-SHA256 of the sender's WhatsApp ID with SENDER_HASH_SALT. The same sender always gets the same hash; the phone number cannot be recovered from it. |
| `sent_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the sender posted the message (WhatsApp timestamp). |
| `text` | text | yes |  | Message text or media caption, as written. Null for media without a caption. |
| `quoted_wa_message_id` | text | yes |  | WhatsApp ID of the message this one replies to, if any. |
| `edit_of_wa_message_id` | text | yes |  | For an edit: WhatsApp ID of the original message. The edited text is stored as a new row. |
| `media_type` | text | no |  | `none`, `image`, `video`, `audio` (including voice notes) or `document`. |
| `is_forwarded` | boolean | no |  | Whether WhatsApp marked the message as forwarded. |
| `deleted_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  | When the sender deleted the message for everyone. The row is kept. |
| `status` | text | no |  | Processing state: `pending` → `processing` → `processed`, or `skipped` (not a listing) / `failed`. |
| `error` | text | yes |  | Why processing failed or was skipped. |
| `attempts` | integer | no |  | How many times processing has been attempted. |
| `enqueued_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  | When the `preprocess` job was queued. Null while media is still downloading. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When capture stored the message. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was last changed. |

**Indexes and constraints**

- Unique index `messages_group_wa_message_id_key` on (group_id, wa_message_id)
- Index `messages_status_idx` on (status)
- Index `messages_group_sent_at_idx` on (group_id, sent_at)
- Index `messages_sender_sent_at_idx` on (sender_hash, sent_at)
- Check `messages_status_check`
- Check `messages_media_type_check`

## `projects`

Canonical projects (compounds). Each belongs to one developer and one city.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | no | primary key | Identity primary key. |
| `name_en` | text | no |  | Official English name. Used in exports. Unique per developer. |
| `name_ar` | text | no |  | Official Arabic name. |
| `developer_id` | integer | no | → developers.id | The developer that builds this project. |
| `city_id` | integer | no | → cities.id | The city or area the project is in. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was created. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was last changed. |

**Indexes and constraints**

- Unique index `projects_developer_name_en_key` on (developer_id, name_en)
- Index `projects_city_id_idx` on (city_id)

## `units`

One row per unit offering: the 26 Primary Units template columns, then internal columns.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | bigint | no | primary key | Identity primary key. |
| `category` | text | yes |  | Template: Category (Residential, Commercial, Administrative, Medical). Inferred from unit type when not stated. |
| `developer_id` | integer | yes | → developers.id | Template: Developer (exported as the English name). Filled from the project when only the project was named. |
| `project_id` | integer | yes | → projects.id | Template: Project (exported as the English name). |
| `city_id` | integer | yes | → cities.id | Template: City (exported as the English name). |
| `unit_type` | text | yes |  | Template: Unit Type. |
| `unit_code` | text | yes |  | Template: Unit Code, only when the message names a specific unit. |
| `floor` | text | yes |  | Template: Floor, normalized: `Ground`, `Roof`, `3`, or a range `1-5`. |
| `finishing_specs` | text | yes |  | Template: Finishing Specs. |
| `min_area` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  | Template: Min Area (m²). A single size fills Min and Max. |
| `max_area` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  | Template: Max Area (m²). Empty for "starting from". |
| `land_area` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  | Template: Land Area (m²). |
| `garden_area` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  | Template: Garden Area (m²). |
| `outdoor_area` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  | Template: Outdoor Area (m²), terrace or roof. |
| `min_price` | bigint | yes |  | Template: Min Price, in minor units (piastres/cents) of `price_currency`. 650000000 EGP = EGP 6.5M. |
| `max_price` | bigint | yes |  | Template: Max Price, minor units. Empty for "starting from". |
| `delivery_year` | smallint | yes |  | Template: Delivery Year. Empty for ready-to-move units. |
| `maintenance` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  | Template: Maintenance, as stated (percent or amount). |
| `maintenance_currency` | text | yes |  | Template: Maintenance Currency: `EGP`, `USD` or `%`. |
| `cash_discount` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  | Template: Cash Discount, as stated. |
| `cash_discount_currency` | text | yes |  | Template: Cash Discount Currency, for fixed amounts. |
| `cash_discount_type` | text | yes |  | Template: Cash Discount Type: `Percentage` or `Fixed amount`. |
| `down_payment` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  | Template: Down Payment, percent 0-100 (computed from the amount when only an amount was stated). |
| `installments_count` | smallint | yes |  | Template: Installments Count = years x payments per year, computed in code. |
| `bedrooms` | smallint | yes |  | Template: Bedrooms. |
| `bathrooms` | smallint | yes |  | Template: Bathrooms. |
| `notes` | text | yes |  | Template: Notes. Short English note; the export adds "Ready to move" and USD conversion notes. |
| `status` | text | no |  | `active`, `stale` (not seen for a while), `sold` or `withdrawn`. |
| `price_currency` | text | no |  | Currency the prices were stated in (`EGP` or `USD`). The export converts USD to EGP. |
| `down_payment_amount` | bigint | yes |  | Down payment as an amount (minor units), when the message stated an amount. |
| `installment_years` | numeric(12, 2) | yes |  | Length of the payment plan in years. |
| `installment_frequency` | text | yes |  | `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semi-annual` or `annual`. |
| `ready_to_move` | boolean | no |  | True for ready-to-move units. |
| `confidence` | numeric(3, 2) | no |  | 0-1, computed in code from which key fields were found and how well names matched. |
| `needs_review` | boolean | no |  | True when the review queue should check this unit. |
| `review_reasons` | text[] | no |  | Plain-English reasons for review, e.g. `No price`. |
| `extras` | jsonb | no |  | Other data, e.g. names not in the entity list under `unmatched`. |
| `source_message_id` | bigint | no | → messages.id | The message the unit was extracted from. |
| `extraction_run_id` | bigint | yes | → extraction_runs.id | The model call that produced it. |
| `first_seen_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the unit was first posted (message time). |
| `last_seen_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the unit was last posted. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was created. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was last changed. |

**Indexes and constraints**

- Index `units_source_message_idx` on (source_message_id)
- Index `units_project_idx` on (project_id)
- Index `units_city_type_idx` on (city_id, unit_type)
- Index `units_status_idx` on (status)
- Index `units_needs_review_idx` on (needs_review)
- Check `units_category_check`
- Check `units_unit_type_check`
- Check `units_finishing_specs_check`
- Check `units_maintenance_currency_check`
- Check `units_cash_discount_currency_check`
- Check `units_cash_discount_type_check`
- Check `units_status_check`
- Check `units_price_currency_check`
- Check `units_installment_frequency_check`
- Check `units_down_payment_range`
- Check `units_price_order`

## `wa_auth`

WhatsApp login keys for each account. Losing this table means pairing the number again. **Secret**: anyone with these rows can act as the WhatsApp account.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | text | no |  | `scraper` (capture) or, from Phase 7, `query-bot`. |
| `category` | text | no |  | Key type used by Baileys (`creds`, `pre-key`, `session`, ...). |
| `key_id` | text | no |  | Key identifier within the category. |
| `value` | jsonb | no |  | The key, as JSON (binary values base64-encoded). |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the key was last written. |

## `wa_connections`

Current connection status of each WhatsApp account.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | text | no | primary key | `scraper` or `query-bot`. |
| `state` | text | no |  | `starting`, `awaiting_pairing` (QR or pairing code shown), `open`, `reconnecting`, `logged_out` or `stopped`. |
| `qr` | text | yes |  | The current pairing QR code (as text) while awaiting pairing. |
| `pairing_code` | text | yes |  | The current 8-character pairing code, when pairing by phone number. |
| `last_connected_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  | When the connection last opened. |
| `last_disconnected_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  | When the connection last closed. |
| `last_disconnect_reason` | text | yes |  | Why it last closed, e.g. `connectionLost (408)`. |
| `last_message_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  | When the last message was received from any group. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the status last changed. |

**Indexes and constraints**

- Check `wa_connections_state_check`

## `wa_groups`

Every WhatsApp group the scraper number is in. Only groups with `watched = true` have their messages stored.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Keys | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | no | primary key | Identity primary key. |
| `jid` | text | no | unique | WhatsApp group ID (ends in `@g.us`). Unique. |
| `name` | text | yes |  | Group name as shown in WhatsApp. Updated when it changes. |
| `watched` | boolean | no |  | Whether messages from this group are captured. New groups start unwatched. |
| `source_type` | text | yes |  | Who posts in the group: `developer` or `broker`. Set by the owner. |
| `is_member` | boolean | no |  | False once the scraper number has left or been removed from the group. |
| `last_message_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  | When the last stored message from this group was received. |
| `added_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When capture first saw the group. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  | When the row was last changed. |

**Indexes and constraints**

- Check `wa_groups_source_type_check`
